test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who arranged the elements with chemically similar properties, such as lithium, sodium, and potassium, and showed that the properties of the middle element could be predicted from the properties of the other two?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Johann Dobereiner**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Dobereiner **stated in his **law of triads **that **the arithmetic means of the atomic masses **of the **first and third element **in **a triad **would be **approximately equal **to **the atomic mass **of the **second element **in **that triad**.
 
• Also, when **elements are arranged **in **order of increasing atomic masses**, **groups of three elements(triads**), having **similar chemical properties **are obtained.
 
• The main **Limitation of Dobereiner's classification **of **elements was **that he **failed to arrange **all the **then-known elements in the form of triads **of elements having **similar chemical properties**.
 
• The **first of Dobereiner's triads **was **identified **in the **year 1817 **and was **constituted by **the **alkaline earth metals calcium, strontium, and barium.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lother Meyer **was the **first person **to recognize the **periodic trends **in **the properties of elements**, and **the graph **shows the **pattern **he saw in the **atomic volume **of an **element plotted **against its **atomic weight**.
 
• **John Newlands **was the **first to arrange **the **elements **into a **periodic table **with **increasing order **of **atomic masses**.
 
• **Dmitri Mendeleev **devised the periodic classification of the **chemical elements**, in which the **elements **were **arranged **in **order of increasing atomic weight**.
